title: The Bain Sakina ke Abbas Nahi Aaye
body:
The bayn Sakina ke Abbas nahi aaye-2
<<DIVIDER>>
Dariya par gaye aise - Abbas nahi aaye
<<MINI>>
The bayn Sakina ke Abbas nahi aaye–2
<<DIVIDER>>
Aisa to na hota tha jab tak the madine mein–2
Kiya karbobala aaye–2, --- Abbas nahi aaye
<<MINI>>
The bayn Sakina ke Abbas nahi aaye–2
<<DIVIDER>>
Ek main bhi na thi pyaasi bachche bhi to pyase the-2 kyun rooth gaye mujh se–2, --- Abbas nahi aaye
<<MINI>>
The bayn Sakina ke Abbas nahi aaye–2
<<DIVIDER>>
Panchhi hon ke manus hon har Shaam palat'te hain
Kya baat khuda jaane–2, --- Abbas nahi aaye
<<MINI>>
The bayn Sakina ke Abbas nahi aaye–2
<<DIVIDER>>
Keh de koi sughra se hum bhule nahi tujh ko-2
Hum kab ke ghar aa jate–2, --- Abbas nahi aaye
<<MINI>>
The bayn Sakina ke Abbas nahi aaye–2
<<DIVIDER>>
Ab chadare Zainab ka Allah muhafiz hai-2
Parde ke jo zamin the–2, --- Abbas nahi aaye
<<MINI>>
The bayn Sakina ke Abbas nahi aaye–2
<<DIVIDER>>
Bimar bhatije par nanhi si bhatiji par-2
Kya kya na sitam toote–2, --- Abbas nahi aaye
<<MINI>>
The bayn Sakina ke Abbas nahi aaye–2
<<DIVIDER>>
Darbar ki araish aur qaidi rasan basta-2
Chaubees paher guzre–2, --- Abbas nahi aaye
<<MINI>>
The bayn Sakina ke Abbas nahi aaye–2
<<DIVIDER>>
Kuch yaad nahi aataa aisa hi huwa sibte-2
Jafar ke bulaane se–2, --- Abbas nahi aaye
<<MINI>>
The bayn Sakina ke Abbas nahi aaye–2
